risk_note: RV2 (app.module, linking). Real rebate quoter wired: APP_ENV=prod or any live union endpoint -> commission createCommissionRebateQuoter (rule reader, identity level reader, QUOTE_CONFIG); otherwise the demo quoter (protected demo-quote test unchanged); real quoter without a DB handle fails at start-up, never falls back. Inside a link open the rule, level and config ports are wrapped by linking's openScopedReader (pre-read, then answers only from it; unprepared reads fail with OpenReadNotPrepared; outside an open they read through); rule versions are cut at this open's own pre-read instant, so a version effective or revoked after the pre-read is never used. The quoter's prepare() is not called in production (process-wide state, follow-up). LinkOpenReadPlan carries callerUserId (the requote card's viewer is the caller). Two 'blocked on B2-03' TODOs removed.
